title: Harp's Haven Carriage House | Royal Destinations
meta_description: 30A Pet Friendly Carriage House Rental in Rosemary Beach- Harp's Haven Carriage House by Royal Destinations
description_expanded: Description: Harp's Haven Carriage House by Royal Destinations Location: Rosemary Beach Address: 52 Scout Lane Details: Coastal charm meets modern comfort! Step into Harp's Haven Carriage House, a beautifully designed full-size carriage house offering 550 square feet of stylish, open-concept living. The inviting layout includes a comfortable living area with a sleeper sofa, a cozy dining space for four, and a fully equipped kitchen featuring premium KitchenAid appliances—perfect for cooking up your favorite meals. The king master suite provides a peaceful retreat just off the main living area, complete with a spacious full bathroom and the convenience of a full-size washer and dryer. Ideal for couples or small families, this charming carriage house blends coastal elegance with all the comforts of home making it the perfect spot for your next 30A getaway. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Walking Distance to the Cabana Pool - Indoor Dining for 4 - Coffee Maker - Pet Friendly with approval *Additional Fee Applicable $350 each (pre-tax) *Please contact Reservations for approval prior to your stay. Rosemary Beach Neighborhood Highlights: -Walking Trails and Meandering Boardwalks -A short bike ride to Alys and Seacrest Beach -An Abundance of Green Spaces -4 Swimming Pools -Tennis Facility (Fees Applicable) -Fitness Center (Fees Applicable) -Bike Community -Playground Carriage House: King Bedroom Living Room - Queen Sleeper sofa Fully Equipped Kitchen, Living Room and Laundry Please Note: Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- For over a decade, our family has enjoyed 30A, from WaterColor to Seacrest, but Rosemary Beach holds a special place in our hearts. Its welcoming atmosphere, stunning beaches, and relaxed vibe invite you to slow down and enjoy life. We love being able to walk to great restaurants and shops. We designed our home as a true retreat, a place to reconnect, relax, and make lasting memories. With plenty of space for everyone, it’s a perfect blend of comfort and privacy, so no one ever feels cramped. Whether recharging or spending time together, we hope you find it as special as we do. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
